'''Artorias''' was a peace-loving [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with few defenses. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the onset of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the world was invaded and conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|eponymous]] [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Species/Legends|race]].

==Description==
Artorias was a [[Star/Legends|sunny]] world, with [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="INV01" /> one of which was the [[Great Sea of Artorias]].<ref name="INVref05" /> Buildings generally were built from [[Color/Legends|white]] stone. Much of the world's terrain, and many of its buildings, were massively damaged by the Yuuzhan Vong invasion.<ref name="INVref02">[[Invasion 2|''Invasion'' 2]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:Artorias_swinvasion.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Artorias prior to the Yuuzhan Vong invasion]]

Since the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Caled Galfridian]]. The planet was opposed to the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Galfridian fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. When it was rumored that the Empire would be expanding its presence into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], Galfridian returned to the planet to oversee construction of a [[Artorian safe haven|deep sea shelter]] to protect the populace. However, by the time the shelter was finished, the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was over. After the war, many refugees seeking a peaceful existence emigrated to Artorias.<ref name="INVref05" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> it became one of the first planets to [[Battle of Artorias|fall]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]]. The planet's ecosystem was [[Terraforming/Legends|altered]] by the Yuuzhan Vong to serve [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|their empire]], and its inhabitants were either evacuated, [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]], or [[Death/Legends|killed]]. A [[Artorias resistance|resistance force]] was formed under King Caled to disrupt the [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]], using powerful explosives planted in key areas of the terraforming facilities.<ref name="Inv1">[[Invasion 1|''Invasion'' 1]]</ref>

==Locations==
Artorias hosted a planetary communications center as well as a safe redoubt built by Caled Galfridian in the Great Sea of Artorias during the Galactic Civil War, which was used by him and the Artorias resistance against the Yuuzhan Vong.

==Inhabitants==
The [[Galfridian family]] was native to Artorias; King Caled Galfridian served as the planet's ruler and the leader of its resistance during the Yuuzhan Vong occupation.

==Behind the scenes==
Artorias first appeared in ''[[Invasion 0, Part 1]]'', the first installment of the [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novel]] arc ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]''.<ref name="INV01" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' appendices incorrectly placed the Artorias system to the grid coordinates L-2, while maps of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] placed it to K-3, near [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Online Companion'']] corrected the coordinates.<ref name="EAOC" />
